brief: Create EXACTLY ONE screenshot of ONE Buildrick desktop website-builder editor at 1440x900. No triptych, no comparison board, no panels titled Alternative A/B/C, no multiple screenshots. Realistic app UI only. SAME CONTENT: site Studio, page Contact, modest white webpage with Contact heading, selected form Email/Message/Send. Light editor chrome, 56px header showing Studio / Contact, Document saved, Layout preview, Publish; 60px rail Add/Layers/Pages/Assets/CMS/Brand; 280px Layers tree with Contact form selected. Preserve canvas as primary work area. Right inspector identity Contact form, tabs Style/Behaviour/Effects, Behaviour active, scope text Form settings - all breakpoints, Fields Email/Message list and Add field, After submit subsection with select showing Show message, Message input Thanks for writing., status Server saved, link View submissions pointing to Site settings. This server status is independent of Document saved. Viewport Desktop/Base is canvas view scope not field setting. Font Inter 12-14px max600, Geist Mono numbers, accent #1A56DB, light neutrals, gray borders, 4px spacing scale, compact 28/32px rows, 4/6/8px control corners. No cards, gradients, decorative illustrations or shadows. Do not invent functionality. Do not change canvas content between alternatives. No Figma. One screen only. Layout A: fixed 300px right inspector, long control labels stacked above inputs, existing simple density. No resize handles or additional sheets.
